slug: 2025-06-04 Namibia targets 100% telecom coverage nationwide by 2030

facts.fact: Ecofin Agency (4 June 2025) reports that the government's rural connectivity push is backed by the Universal Service Fund, launched in March 2024 with an initial endowment of N$145 million (about US$8 million); the text does not name the law that set the fund up.

note: Fund launch date of March 2024 is as the article states it; no budget amount for a digital ministry is given.
